page.layout: One page of text in a single full-width column, with a running head and page number at the top and a gathering signature at the foot. The paragraphs are numbered XII and XIII in the text.

Ita Patri regnum tradet & subjicietur Filius. Ad regendos enim
atque in beatitudine & gloria conseruandos glorificatos sola
diuinitatis efficacitas abundè sufficiet, nec erit opus ut Filius, qua-

XII. Alterum Socini peccatum in illis verbis est illa ipsa ar-
gumentationis Apostolicæ inuersio, quam in eo iam reprehendi.
Conatur enim explicare, qnomodo quicunque genua flectet
Christo, ea flectet etiam Deo, id quod ad exponendam argu-
mentationem Apostoli nihil prorsus facit. Non enim Apostolus
ex eo quod omne genu flectetur Christo concludit omne genu
flexum iri Deo, sed contrà ex eo quod flectetur Deo concludit
flexum iri Christo. Itaque frustrà laborat Socinus in deducenda
consequentia à Christo ad Deum: aberrat enim ab Apostoli sco-
po & verbis.

page.notes: The running head is read as "EX ESAIÆ CAP. 45. VER. 23." The "Vf." is taken as VER. The word at the end of the page, "pra-terea", is hard to read because of the line break and the ligature, so the reading "præ-terea" is not certain; the printed hyphen is kept as seen. "qnomodo" is printed that way and is left as it is. The spacing before "?" in "Deo ?" is copied as printed. The page has no catchword.
